name: IQ Puzzles — Level 15
subtitle: Joe Cameron · Level 15
description: 23 verbatim puzzles from Level 15, with official solutions.
sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which number is missing?
questions.explanation: Square each number in the inner ring and take away the original number. Write the answer in the outer ring opposite.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which number goes in the empty box?
questions.explanation: Taking the first two lines as one group starting top left and the bottom two lines as the second group starting bottom right and moving clockwise around each one, the first number in the top group is doubled to give the corresponding value in the second group, the next is halved etc.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which watch comes next?
questions.explanation: The sum of the separate digits on each watch add up to 18.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which playing cards are missing?
questions.correctAnswer: Nine of Spades, Nine of Diamonds, Seven of Spades and Two of Spades.
questions.explanation: In each row, spades represent positive numbers and diamonds represent negative numbers. The card on the far right of each row represents the sum of the cards to the left.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which number is missing from the last circle?
questions.explanation: In each circle starting top left and going clockwise, double the first number and subtract 2 to give the next value.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which of the bottom boxes finishes the sequence?
questions.explanation: If viewed from the left edge the boxes show numbers 1-6.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which card is missing?
questions.explanation: In each row, as you move to the right, the values increase by 2, 3 and 4 with each suit appearing once in each row.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: What is the sum of the dots on the hidden faces of these dice?
questions.explanation: Opposite sides of a dice add up to 7, giving 21 dots per dice. Multiply this by three and take away the dots you can see.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which number is missing from the chain?
questions.explanation: Going clockwise add 4 to get the next number, then subtract 2, etc.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which numbers need to be placed in the circles in the bottom two boxes?
questions.explanation: In each square the central value equals the sum of the product of the top two numbers and the product of the bottom two.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which number goes in the empty circle?
questions.explanation: Starting at the bottom left, move to the right diagonally up, then diagonally down etc. increasing the numerical value by 4 each step. Additionally the two figures remaining in each group add up to the centre figure.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which number replaces the question mark?
questions.explanation: The centre figure is the difference between the product of the top two numbers and the product of the bottom two.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which playing cards are missing from this puzzle?
questions.correctAnswer: From left to right - Nine of Diamonds, Jack of Hearts, Six of Clubs and Queen of Hearts.
questions.explanation: Starting at the top left, cards move clockwise in a spiral in the repeating sequence 2, 9, 5, Q, A, 3, 6, J, K. The suits follow the sequence H,C,H,S,S, D in an anticlockwise formation.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which letter replaces the blank and completes the sequence?
questions.explanation: Starting at the top letters increase in steps of three for the left hand column and four for the right hand column whilst missing out all the vowels.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which number goes at the bottom of the column?
questions.explanation: Numbers increase by 7, then 6, 5, 4 and 3.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: What is missing from the empty ellipse?
questions.explanation: The centre figure equals the sum of the numerical alphabetical value of the left hand letter and the reverse alphabetical value of the right hand letter.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Fill in the empty box.
questions.explanation: Starting on the left on the first group and moving up and down towards the right, numbers increase by 2 and 3. In the second group by 3 and 4 and in the third group by 4 and 5.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: What is missing from the empty segment?
questions.explanation: Moving from left to right, letters in the top circles increase in value from one circle to the next by the corresponding numbers in the circles below.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which letter goes in the middle of the third triangle?
questions.explanation: Starting at the top of each triangle, letters move forward by three places going clockwise, ending in the centre.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which letter goes in the empty segment?
questions.explanation: Taking the numerical values of the letters in the left hand circle, multiply them by two to give the values of the corresponding letters in the centre circle. Then multiply by three to give the values in the last circle.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which letter goes in the empty segment?
questions.explanation: In each circle, starting top left and going clockwise multiply the numerical value of each letter by 2 and then subtract 2 to give the next letter.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which number replaces the blank and completes the puzzle?
questions.explanation: Going clockwise around the 4 boxes, the values in corresponding segments increase by 1, 2, 3 and 5.

questions.sourceOrganization: IQ Puzzles — Joe Cameron / Arcturus Publishing
questions.prompt: Which of the smaller grids fits into the middle of the larger one?
questions.explanation: The grid is symmetrical around the bottom axis running from top left to bottom right.
